text:
nina: FYI running into a publish block on the sample-app onboarding branch. CI flagged a regen diff that looks like type ordering noise in generated types, plus changelog bot bumped minor which blocked the release.
dev-bot: buildkite: #4478 failed during regen step (yarn regen) :x:
carl: The diff is tiny but noisy. `src/generated/types.ts` shows field order flip for `OnboardRequest`
zara: That's the same nondeterministic OpenAPI property ordering we saw last quarter. Our typegen sorts by `x-order` when present, otherwise preserves array order, and the OpenAPI generator sometimes returns properties unsorted
ethan: The changelog generator currently treats any file change as a candidate for semver bump type. Since generated types changed it inferred a minor. We should ignore generated files with a `.generated` suffix or add a `.semver-ignore` config
marta: Quick workaround: revert the expected golden file in the repo to match the stable typegen run and add a GitHub Action step to run `yarn typegen --stable` during pre-merge.
nina: Who wants to add the `.semver-ignore` entry? I can add the CI env var fix. The sample-app onboarding script does `if [ -z "$REDWOOD_ONBOARD" ] then interactive` which times out in CI
carl: I'll do the semver ignore and open a PR for the typegen action. Also adding a note to the PR template: "run `yarn typegen --stable` locally"
zara: For longer term, should we make typegen deterministic by default? Adding `--stable` as opt-in is causing regressions
ina: Agreed. File a small RFC? Also cc'ing infra to make sure node versions align across runners; prettier/tsc minor diffs can change emitted output
dev-bot: nina pushed a CI fix, build retriggered :arrow_forward:
carl: New build passed regen, failing e2e due to onboarding env var still 
marta: I added REDWOOD_ONBOARD=false to the CI matrix and pushed the skip flag. Rerunning
dev-bot: buildkite: #4478 rerun succeeded :white_check_mark:
ethan: Postmortem item: update changelog bot logic to consult a .semver-ignore file and treat changes to ignored files as docs-only
ina: Thanks team. I'll merge once the release branch is green. Also adding a short devex note about deterministic typegen and the `--stable` flag. :sparkles:
